push.title: L 3-9 vs Inter Hornz | You: 7.0 (7th worst match performance)

strengths.coach: When you went in, you came out with the ball. That's timing.

weaknesses.detail: Passes attempted: 13 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 15 or less)
weaknesses.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.
Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.
Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.
weaknesses.coach: We didn't see enough of you on the ball. I want you in the thick of it.

weaknesses.detail: Rating 0.6 below what their on-ball stats predict
weaknesses.title: Off-ball positioning
tips: Hold your spot in the shape when the ball's on the far side. Drifting leaves the back line naked.
Your rating came in lower than your stats say, and that gap is off-ball: positioning, interceptions, blocks.
Hold the line with your partner and step up together. Don't let a dropping striker drag you out.
weaknesses.coach: The stats say you did more than the rating gives you credit for. That gap is off-ball positioning.

push.body:
buddskees, a 6.5 against Inter Hornz. I'm not mad. I'm motivated, and I need you motivated too.

- You and BellyTb1 share this one: on-ball involvement. Tandem fix: make triangles, 1-2 touch.
- 1.4 down on your average. Tomorrow's a fresh page.
- That 6.5 is your 3rd worst match performance. One game, one lesson.
